# Bounded live attachment verification

These files contain synthetic test text only. They are ground truth, not test results.

- `live20d-marker.png`: SAATHI TEST FIXTURE; INDIGO-2081; 17 MINUTES.
- `live20d-citations.pdf`, page 1: AMBER-2081; study duration 17 minutes; Probability.
- Same PDF, page 2: COBALT-9042; practice duration 23 minutes; Fractions.
- Neither file gives a moon count for Aurelia. File-only answers must state that this is absent.

Use the ordinary Saathi attachment UI, preserve file-only selection and exact draft on errors,
read available allowance/reset before and after, and verify citations by opening the exact
saved attachment/page links. Do not bypass limits or retry until success. If browser upload
or signed-in access is blocked, report the unrun check. No private notes or teacher material
should be included in AI requests. Fixture preparation is not evidence of live correctness.
